templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from composite-figure by the note-writer: three block diagrams (flow control, retransmission, ICRC pipeline) are fully independent modules with no shared component, dominant panel, or dataflow between them; the rule that unrelated panels are two figures, not one, applies directly.
templates.what_to_learn: When three block diagrams genuinely share no component or dataflow, do not force them into one composite just to save space; either draw a connecting line to the larger system they belong to, or split them into separate figures, since grouping unrelated modules under one caption reads as three mini-diagrams, not one architecture.
